Concrete Installation

Decide what the surface needs to do.

The size and use of the area help determine the concrete work. Before installation, discuss the finish, edges, joints, and how the new surface will meet a house, pool, steps, or existing paving. Broom and stamped finishes are options to discuss for the site and scope.

  • Concrete patios, slabs, and pool surrounds
  • Broom and stamped finish options
  • Edges, joints, and connections to existing work
  • Coordination with nearby pavers and steps

How the Work Comes Together

The steps for this project.

Concrete work begins with the intended use and the way the surface connects to the rest of the property.

01

Define the area

Discuss dimensions, intended use, access, and where the concrete will meet buildings or other surfaces.

02

Select the finish

Review available finishes, edges, joints, and transitions for the project scope and site.

03

Place and review

Complete the agreed concrete work, attend to the planned edges and connections, and review the area with you.
